en_title: 'It Was Pretty Traumatic, It Was Hilarious' – Exodus Lead Actors Talk Romance Scenes and Embodying Player Choice
cn_title: 「那经历挺让人受创的，太好笑了」——《Exodus》主演谈浪漫场景与演绎玩家选择
opus_summary: 《Exodus》两位主演Carina Conti和Stephen Oyoung分别饰演主角Jun Aslan的女性和男性版本。他们谈到了如何在演绎玩家不同选择时保持角色的一致性，以及配音工作的挑战；两人也讨论了游戏中的爱情选项。

paragraphs.en: The voice of a main protagonist can carry a ton of weight, both for the characterization of a lead character and as the lens for which players understand a game world. Just look at the impact both Jennifer Hale and Mark Meer had on Commander Shepard in the Mass Effect series, and it's easy to see how actors are just as crucial to these games as the scripts they're given. The upcoming spacefaring sci-fi RPG Exodus seems to be taking the same approach with regard to building up its protagonist, Jun Aslan, as an avatar for players to shape through story choices and a character with a distinct personality at the same time.
paragraphs.cn: 主角的声音可以具有举足轻重的作用，既能塑造主角的形象，也能成为玩家理解游戏世界的视角。只要看看Jennifer Hale和Mark Meer对《质量效应》系列中薛帕德指挥官的影响，就不难发现，对于这类游戏而言，演员和他们拿到的剧本一样至关重要。即将推出的太空科幻RPG《Exodus》在塑造主角Jun Aslan时似乎也采取了同样的方式：Jun既是一个供玩家通过故事选择来塑造的化身，同时也是一个拥有鲜明个性的角色。

paragraphs.en: On the heels of revealing the character model and voice actor for the female version of Jun , I had a conversation with both of Exodus' lead actors – Carina Conti (female Jun) and Stephen Oyoung (male Jun). We talked about the biggest differences between Exodus and their previous roles in TV shows and movies, the nuances of representing the player's choices in acting, and why Jun is important to them. But we also touch on acting out all the romance options that will be in Exodus , and the importance of having rizz . It was all fun and games with no shortage of jokes, so enjoy!
paragraphs.cn: 在女性版Jun的角色模型和配音演员公布后不久，我与《Exodus》的两位主演Carina Conti（女性版Jun）和Stephen Oyoung（男性版Jun）聊了聊。我们谈到了《Exodus》与他们此前在电视剧和电影中出演的角色之间最大的区别、在表演中体现玩家选择的微妙之处，以及Jun为何对他们如此重要。我们还谈到了如何演绎《Exodus》中的所有浪漫选项，以及拥有魅力的重要性。整个过程轻松愉快，笑话不断，尽情享受吧！

paragraphs.en: IGN: What is it about Jun that draws you now that you are on the other end of embodying this character now that you have put yourself out there as the lead for Exodus? What has been the thing that draws you to Jun?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：既然你们已经以《Exodus》主演的身份亮相，也已经完成了对这个角色的演绎，那么现在Jun身上有什么吸引你们的地方？是什么吸引你们关注Jun？

paragraphs.en: Carina Conti: I love her [female Jun], I'm a little bit obsessed with her! She embodies qualities that I really envision for my future self. And so, getting to practice those within her over the course of six months was such a luxury. It was like, what if you already got to play this version of yourself where you are powerful, confident, and courageous, and a leader of men where you really have your ducks in a row. The great part about playing Jun, you get to play that character from every moment of that journey, building toward everything that they can become. You're already them where you take them as they as, and you're them when they become your aspirational version.
paragraphs.cn: Carina Conti：我爱她［女性版Jun］，我有点迷上她了！她身上体现出的品质，正是我真正期望未来的自己拥有的。所以，能在六个月的时间里通过她来实践这些品质，实在是一种奢侈。这就像是，你已经有机会扮演这样一个版本的自己：强大、自信、勇敢，能领导众人，而且一切都安排得井井有条。扮演Jun的美妙之处在于，你可以演绎这个角色在那段旅程中的每一个时刻，逐步走向她可能成为的各种模样。你接手她原本的样子时，就已经是她；当她成为你所向往的模样时，你也是她。

paragraphs.en: Stephen Oyoung: I think I'm just drawn to, in so many words, the hero's journey. I think Jun is fundamentally a good person thrown into these extremely challenging situations. I love that Jun is tough, but I love that Jun also feels very deeply. And that to me was one of the coolest things, to see Jun as a leader. This Jun is a fighter, but also gets heartbroken and is vulnerable enough to experience that, as well as they should, because again, the journey that Jun goes on is vast and it changes all the people and creatures around him, especially through time dilation.
paragraphs.cn: Stephen Oyoung：简单来说，我想吸引我的是英雄之旅。我认为Jun本质上是个好人，只是被抛进了这些极具挑战性的处境。我喜欢Jun的坚韧，也喜欢Jun感情深厚。对我来说，最棒的事情之一就是看到身为领袖的Jun。这个Jun是一名战士，但也会心碎，并且足够脆弱，能够体验到这种痛苦；他也理应如此，因为Jun所踏上的旅程非常漫长，它改变了他身边所有的人和生物，尤其是通过时间膨胀。

paragraphs.en: IGN: One of the things you touched on, Stephen, was feeling June as a fundamentally good person and a leader. The thing is that this game has choices, so I want to talk about striking different tones – as you go through a script and have branching paths, I want to get an idea of y'all's approach to embodying those different tones for the same character. And the perspectives on how you handle different attitudes for Jun depending on player choices?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：Stephen，你刚才提到，你觉得Jun本质上是个好人，也是一名领袖。但这款游戏有各种选择，所以我想谈谈如何表现不同的基调——当你们读剧本、面对分支路线时，我想了解你们如何为同一个角色演绎这些不同的基调。对于如何根据玩家的选择处理Jun的不同态度，你们又有什么看法？

paragraphs.en: CC: I think that we all contain multitudes and we all have the potential to be one thing or another at all times, sometimes depending on how we slept that day! The actor's job is to justify the script and to justify the circumstances that were given. And so that's the greatest challenge that you can give an actor. One of them, at least, is to fundamentally be this person , but to do so in a certain kind of way – maybe in a selfish way as the character. You can choose to do these kinds of things with any line, and it's never polarized that way exactly because there's a whole spectrum, which I love about the writing in the story. That was kind of the hard work Stephen and I had to do to justify this reality.
paragraphs.cn: CC：我认为我们每个人都有很多面，我们随时都有可能成为这样或那样的人，有时还取决于那天睡得怎么样！演员的工作是让剧本和给定的情境显得合情合理。所以，这是你能给演员的最大挑战。至少其中一个挑战是，从根本上成为这个人，但又要以某种特定的方式去做——也许是以角色自私的一面来表现。你可以选择对任何一句台词做这样的处理，而且它从来不是非此即彼的，因为中间有一整条光谱，这也是我喜欢这个故事的剧本的地方。Stephen和我必须努力让这种现实显得合理。

paragraphs.en: SO: I give a massive shout out to our cinematic director Tal Peleg. He really made it very clear from day one that whatever choice you do, you have to make sure that when you are portraying that choice, you are still Jun. He cannot flip and be some completely different character. Now, I know I shot myself in the foot because I said Jun is fundamentally good! I suppose I should clarify – when I say good, it's that Jun wants what's best for Lidon [Jun's home planet], always. I spent four years on this game, so in my head I'm always thinking, 'okay, he's heroic,' but heroic can have many different shades. And sometimes that can objectively look pretty bad, so let's just rewind that before everybody at Archetype [the developer] gets on my case!
paragraphs.cn: SO：我必须大力赞扬我们的过场动画导演Tal Peleg。从第一天起，他就说得非常清楚：无论做出什么选择，在演绎那个选择时，你都必须确保自己仍然是Jun。他不能突然变成一个完全不同的角色。现在，我知道我给自己挖坑了，因为我说Jun本质上是个好人！我想我应该澄清一下——我说的好，是指Jun始终希望对Lidon［Jun的母星］来说最好的事情发生。我在这款游戏上花了四年时间，所以我脑子里总想着「好吧，他是个英雄」，但英雄也可以有很多不同的面貌。有时从客观上看，那可能相当糟糕，所以趁Archetype［开发商］的所有人来找我算账之前，我们还是把刚才的话收回吧！

paragraphs.en: CC: It's the most relatable thing possible, which is that Jun wants the best for the people they love, you know?
paragraphs.cn: CC：这是再容易让人产生共鸣不过的事了，就是Jun希望自己所爱的人得到最好的，你知道吗？

paragraphs.en: SO: And how he goes about that can make him look like a boy scout or it can crash and burn, that's something for the player to see!
paragraphs.cn: SO：而他实现这一点的方式，可能让他看起来像个模范童子军，也可能彻底搞砸，这就留给玩家自己去看了！

paragraphs.en: IGN: Of course, voice acting is in a very different realm than acting itself. Carina, a lot of your background is in TV and stage. Stephen, you've done movies and games as well. I want to talk a little bit about how different voice acting is for y'all and what served as inspiration for crafting your version of Jun, or if you just shot from the hip and said, yup, that's my Jun!
paragraphs.cn: IGN：当然，配音表演和表演本身属于截然不同的领域。Carina，你的很多经历都来自电视和舞台。Stephen，你也演过电影和游戏。我想聊聊配音表演对你们来说有多么不同，以及在塑造你们各自版本的Jun时，什么给了你们灵感；或者你们只是凭直觉发挥，然后说，没错，这就是我的Jun！

paragraphs.en: CC: I'll start by saying voice acting is really hard! It was difficult, and I would actually prefer to be on a mocap stage which I think this is one of the hardest forms of acting – you have to use so much imagination, create your own senses and memory, or whatever your process is. It's a lot of effort on the actor's part. For voice acting, I will say it's equally difficult and I certainly found it a challenge. I did my best to approach it as though I were in that space. And the reason it was difficult was because I was doing all the imaginative work of believing that I am in the space that Jun is in, believing I'm in those circumstances, believing that the stress was real, that what has been happening for the past two hours was real, and what's happening right after was real. But in reality, you are on your own in a small padded room with a microphone. So yeah, really challenging from an acting perspective.
paragraphs.cn: CC：首先我要说，配音表演真的很难！这很困难，而实际上我更愿意待在动作捕捉舞台上，我认为这是最难的表演形式之一——你必须运用大量想象力，创造自己的感官体验和记忆，或者采取你自己的任何方法。这需要演员付出很大的努力。至于配音表演，我要说它同样困难，我确实觉得它很有挑战性。我尽力让自己仿佛置身于那个空间中。困难的原因是，我要靠想象让自己相信，我就在Jun所在的空间里，相信自己身处那些情境，相信压力是真实的，过去两个小时发生的事是真实的，紧接着要发生的事也是真实的。但实际上，你只是独自待在一个有软垫的小房间里，面前放着一支麦克风。所以，是的，从表演的角度来看，这真的很有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: In terms of my take on the character, I had the same approach that I have for every character, which is to find the overlap between that character and myself. That overlap can be literal, but more often it is emotional. Like, do I know what it feels like to be on my own? Do I know what it feels like to have been abandoned? Do I know what it feels like to have the odds stacked against me and have them feel insurmountable? Do I know what it feels like to be scrappy and hardworking? All those things came together to build my foundation for Jun. And those are things I hope to build within myself, which is that aspect of leadership, courage, or willingness to try new things and be brave and bold and risk it all.
paragraphs.cn: 至于我对这个角色的理解，我采用的方法和对待每个角色时一样，就是寻找角色与我自己的重合之处。这种重合可以是字面上的，但更多时候是情感上的。比如，我知道独自一人是什么感觉吗？我知道被抛弃是什么感觉吗？我知道处境对自己极为不利，而且困难似乎无法克服是什么感觉吗？我知道顽强拼搏、努力工作是什么感觉吗？所有这些共同构成了我塑造Jun的基础。这些也是我希望在自己身上培养的东西，也就是领导力、勇气，或者尝试新事物、勇敢大胆、冒上一切风险的意愿。

paragraphs.en: SO: For me, I leaned so heavily on the writing. The writing informed everything. I knew this character had a specific background that you begin with, and after that, it just became a tight rope of wanting to give male June personality and also wanting it to be open for the player to be able to inject themselves into choices versus the player just being on rails like watching a movie unfold. I really wanted the player to feel like they were saying these lines. So every time I would have a line, I was trying my level best not to perform it as if it was a stage play, like ' watch me act! ' It was more like, I hope this is how a regular, normal person would say this in this situation.
paragraphs.cn: SO：对我来说，我非常依赖剧本。剧本决定了一切。我知道这个角色一开始有特定的背景，而在那之后，就像走钢丝一样：我既想赋予男性版Jun个性，又想留出空间，让玩家能够在选择中融入自己，而不是让玩家像沿着固定轨道前进一样，只是在看一部电影展开。我真的希望玩家感觉这些台词是自己说的。所以每次拿到一句台词，我都尽最大努力不把它演得像舞台剧一样，仿佛在说「看我表演！」更像是，我希望一个普通人在这种情况下会这么说。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Putting yourself out there, seeing this character in motion, and hearing yourself but having players in control of what you say – does that cross your mind? How do you feel about that unique element for this game in particular?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：将自己展现在公众面前，看到这个角色动起来，听到自己的声音，但你说什么却由玩家控制——你们会想到这一点吗？你们对这款游戏特有的这个要素有什么感受？

paragraphs.en: CC: I feel like I have to kind of emotionally sever and take a step back once my job is done. It's truly one of the greatest joys of working on a project like this. Everyone is so incredibly talented and so capable beyond what you even imagine. What they produce is, I have no words! I'm so impressed and excited. But that's like where my job ends, it's emotionally kind of where I sever it. And then the rest is just trusting everyone else to do their best. The result as far as I've seen is greater than I ever could have imagined. There is a detachment that happens, so when I see female Jun for the first time, it's really trippy. It's also like, that doesn't exactly feel like me, it's just like this very cool character that I've been part of creating, you know?
paragraphs.cn: CC：我觉得一旦我的工作完成，就必须在情感上稍微抽离，退后一步。这确实是参与这样一个项目最大的乐趣之一。每个人都才华横溢、能力超群，甚至超乎你的想象。他们做出来的东西，我都说不出话来了！我非常佩服，也非常兴奋。但我的工作大概就到此为止了，在情感上我也差不多是在这里抽离。之后剩下的就是相信其他所有人都会尽自己所能。就我目前看到的成果而言，它比我能想象的还要出色。这其中会产生一种抽离感，所以当我第一次看到女性版Jun时，感觉真的很奇妙。同时也会觉得，那并不完全像我，她只是一个我参与创造的、非常酷的角色，你知道吗？

paragraphs.en: SO: This already goes to show the duality of man, we are going to be very different male and female Juns because I take everything personally! I am so invested in the success of this project in a way you would not believe! But yeah, seeing my voice on a new face is obviously unreal, super weird, but my deepest hope is that people can identify with the voice and with the face, and that they can, I guess, imprint both together, really. As far as them controlling him, I just want to see all the playthroughs because I want to see every option. I'm glad they can control me, go for it! You know, we're just actors or puppets on strings, this is what we were made for!
paragraphs.cn: SO：这已经说明了人性的两面，我们的男性版和女性版Jun会非常不同，因为我对所有事情都非常在意！我对这个项目能否成功投入的心血，绝对超乎你的想象！不过，是的，看到自己的声音配上一张新面孔，显然很不真实、超级奇怪，但我最深切的希望是，人们能认同这个声音和这张脸，而且我想，他们能真正把两者联系在一起。至于他们控制他这件事，我只想看看所有的通关过程，因为我想看到每一个选项。我很高兴他们能控制我，放手去做吧！你知道，我们只是演员，或者提线木偶，我们生来就是干这个的！

paragraphs.en: IGN: You two have your own way of embodying Jun with different approaches even if they're essentially the same character. But did y'all conspire with each other on how you should do certain parts, or was there any improvisation that stuck?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：尽管本质上是同一个角色，你们两人还是各自用了不同的方法来演绎Jun。但你们有没有一起商量过某些部分该怎么演，或者有没有即兴发挥的内容被保留下来？

paragraphs.en: CC: 'Conspire' is such a good word.
paragraphs.cn: CC：「商量」这个词用得真好。

paragraphs.en: SO: Carina is going to get tired of hearing me say this, but we did not meet until like last week, but I think that's a good thing. It's great because I think actors should approach their character, their life with their own thing. And not telling me about it because in real life, that's how we approach other people as well. I don't know about other people's lives, so let's all just discover it together. And again, inwardly, I was competing. I am still competing with Carina! She's so cool and she kept me on my feet. Every recording session, I was thinking I must bring my A-game because I know whoever they get [for female Jun] is going to do the same. Then when I saw it was Carina, and I was like, 'okay, here we go, now we're off to the races.'
paragraphs.cn: SO：Carina听我说这件事都要听腻了，但我们直到大约上周才见面，不过我认为这是件好事。这很棒，因为我觉得演员应该用自己的方式去理解自己的角色和角色的人生。而且不告诉我，因为在现实生活中，我们也是这样认识其他人的。我不了解别人的生活，所以我们就一起去发现吧。还有，我内心一直在竞争。我现在还在和Carina竞争！她太酷了，她让我不敢松懈。每次录音时我都在想，我必须拿出最佳状态，因为我知道不管他们找谁来演［女性版Jun］，对方都会这么做。然后当我看到是Carina时，我就想：「好吧，来了，现在比赛开始了。」

paragraphs.en: CC : You gotta be worth the investment and give it everything if you're going to do the main character twice with a branching script, make it worth it!
paragraphs.cn: CC：如果你要用一份有分支的剧本把主角演两遍，就得对得起这份投入，全力以赴，让这一切值得！

paragraphs.en: SO: I always say I'm a fan of Carina. I think the first time I heard her voice, there's this very special quality that Carina has where you haven't heard that kind of voice before. It's so memorable and every scene she does she knocks out of the park. And that's coming from a hater! So…now you know!
paragraphs.cn: SO：我总说我是Carina的粉丝。我想，第一次听到她的声音时就觉得，Carina有一种非常特别的特质，你以前从未听过那样的声音。那声音令人难忘，她演的每一场戏都精彩绝伦。而这话还是从一个黑粉嘴里说出来的！所以……现在你知道了！

paragraphs.en: CC: I'm never going to get sick of hearing you say that! But to give Stephen his flowers as well – there were so many moments where if I was matching Steven or doing my best to match Steven's mouth movements, if the cinematic had already been rendered, instead of doing the line, I just paused and was like, 'Oh my God, Steven's voice is so beautiful.' There are different qualities in our voices, obviously naturally, but I also think based on nurture and our personalities and our backgrounds. And I think that adds something that's really unexpected for the different versions of Jun, and that's inextricable from the character experience. So, play it and find out. We're such good salesmen!
paragraphs.cn: CC：你这么说我永远都听不腻！不过也得夸夸Stephen——有好多次，如果过场动画已经渲染好了，我需要配合Stephen，或者尽力对上Stephen的嘴部动作时，我没有念台词，而是停下来想：「天哪，Stephen的声音真好听。」我们的声音有不同的特质，显然有天生的因素，但我认为也与后天培养、我们的性格和背景有关。我觉得这为不同版本的Jun增添了一些非常出人意料的东西，而这与角色体验密不可分。所以，去玩玩看吧。我们真是优秀的推销员！

paragraphs.en: IGN: Okay, so, many of us come to these games for the romance element…
paragraphs.cn: IGN：好吧，我们很多人玩这类游戏是冲着浪漫元素来的……

paragraphs.en: Stephen : Yes, finally, somebody asked! Alright, here we go!
paragraphs.cn: Stephen：对，终于有人问了！好，我们开始吧！

paragraphs.en: IGN: So, I need to ask y'all about the romances! Take me through what it's like when you have to act out those scenes. Do you have to mentally prepare yourself, like, alright, I gotta turn my swag on, or I gotta rizz up this character?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：所以，我得问问你们那些浪漫情节！跟我说说，你们必须演出那些场景时是什么感觉。你们需要做心理准备吗，比如说，好吧，我得拿出自己的魅力，或者我得迷住这个角色？

paragraphs.en: SO: Okay, well, yes, it's all of those things. Rizz, for sure. First of all, when we're doing mocap, it's very hard to have rizz. You have a camera on your face and a skin-tight suit on. Some people are into that! But us as actors, it was very awkward but we all had a great time, it was very fun. And honestly, with something like that, there's no time to be shy. So, uh, it was very sexy and very fun. But you know, you're pantomiming. In that regard, it was actually very safe and very comfortable. Romance is a very, very fun option in this game.
paragraphs.cn: SO：好吧，是的，所有这些都有。魅力，肯定有。首先，我们做动作捕捉时，很难有什么魅力。你脸上装着摄像头，身上穿着紧身服。有些人就喜欢这个！但对我们演员来说，那非常尴尬，不过我们都玩得很开心，非常有趣。说实话，做那样的事，你没时间害羞。所以，呃，那非常性感，也非常有趣。但你知道，你只是在做哑剧式的表演。从这方面来说，其实很安全，也很舒服。浪漫情节是这款游戏中一个非常、非常有趣的选项。

paragraphs.en: CC: I will say, there was nothing sexy about my experience! It was not flattened, but it was nothing short of weird!
paragraphs.cn: CC：我要说，我的经历可一点都不性感！它并不平淡，但绝对很古怪！

paragraphs.en: SO: Can I say something? The best thing that we ever did…
paragraphs.cn: SO：我能说件事吗？我们做过的最棒的事……

paragraphs.en: SO: Carina and I had to either match each other when we had to make makin' love sounds . And not even doing mocap, we just had to with headphones on in a booth and all of the engineers had to listen. Carina and I both, we were in different sessions, but I remember saying to the engineers, 'Guys, uh, I apologize about the next minute and a half of what you're about to hear.' It was pretty traumatic for all involved, all these kinds of grunts and groans, it was hilarious!
paragraphs.cn: SO：Carina和我在必须发出做爱声响的时候，还得互相配合。甚至不是在做动作捕捉，我们只是得戴着耳机待在录音棚里，而所有工程师都得听着。Carina和我是在不同的录音时段录的，但我记得我对工程师们说：「各位，呃，我先为你们接下来一分半钟要听到的内容道歉。」这对所有参与的人来说都挺让人受创的，各种各样的哼哼声和呻吟声，太好笑了！

paragraphs.en: CC: I met Steven a week ago, but I know him very well!
paragraphs.cn: CC：我一周前才认识Stephen，但我非常了解他！

paragraphs.en: Michael is reviews editor at IGN and regularly contributes with previews, interviews, live events coverage, and news all in written and video form. He's usually entrusted with covering long RPGs and tech products, but he's got range when it comes to games. You'll also catch him at conventions and hosting video content, including IGN's weekly podcast Unlocked .
paragraphs.cn: Michael是IGN的评测编辑，经常以文字和视频形式撰写或制作前瞻、采访、现场活动报道和新闻。他通常负责报道流程较长的RPG和科技产品，但他的游戏涉猎范围很广。你还会在各类展会上看到他，也会看到他主持视频节目，包括IGN的每周播客《Unlocked》。
